Priya (Product): Two quick asks from today's all-hands Q&A: 1) Can leadership confirm rough windows for API GA, Console beta, and Optimize alpha? 2) What's the minimal Optimize alpha surface we must support for internal dogfooding?

Evan (CEO): High-level windows: API GA targeting 2027-05-10, Console beta Q3-ish (around 2027-08-01), Optimize alpha late Sept (2027-09-25). We'll freeze the dates after the risk review next Tue.

Noah (ENG-Platform): Canary proposal for GA: start 1% (24h), step to 5% (72h), then 20% if stable. Rollback on >5% error increase or sustained CPU >85%. Adding a safety throttle for Dedicated customers.

Rhea (SRE): SLOs: classify endpoints into short/long. Short p95 target <180ms, long p95 <700ms, availability 99.9% for GA. Need Product to map endpoints to classes so alerts are meaningful.

Clara (DevEx): Console beta will include model catalog + rollout panel + a basic cost-insights card. Optimize alpha should include batching hints and quantization recommendations only; no automated evals in alpha. UX must be opt-in and clearly labeled.

Priya (Product): Action items: Priya to publish tentative dates to roadmap doc by EOD Mon; Noah to post canary YAML and playbook by Wed; Rhea to draft SLOs and alert runbooks by Wed; Clara to share Console beta feature list by Thu.

Noah (ENG-Platform): Ack. I'll attach example dashboards (error budget burn, p95, cpu).

Rhea (SRE): Ack. I'll draft the incident playbook for rollback steps.

status-bot: Canary deploy initiated: cluster `canary-v1-269120` image `rwd/serve:canary-2027-05-01`

Evan (CEO): Thanks everyone. Once dates are firm I'll coordinate a short partner note.

Priya (Product): Thanks team, I'll follow up with a one-pager and ping for signoff. :thumbsup:
